{{Quote|Many Hutt foods are quite delicious, including this "punky muffin" sandwich. A breakfast favorite on Nar Shaddaa, it features a poached gorg egg, Klatooine paddy frog sausage and a slice of jerba cheese on a Poached gorg egg.|Dex's Diner menu, on the "Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''poached gorg egg''' was [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made from the [[Gorg egg|eggs]] of [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Gorg DB">{{DB|creature|gorg|gorg}}</ref> to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>  [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Gorg DB" />Poached gorg eggs were used to make [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]]es which were enjoyed by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] included a poached gorg egg, [[Klatooine paddy frog sausage]], and a slice of [[jerba cheese]], all on a [[pedunkee mufkin]]. They were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|breakfast]] favorite on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the Hutt homeworld of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] also sold "Hungry Hutt" sandwiches at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Poached gorg egg was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
